judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done document (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec update, and failing acceptance tests, without ever touching the production code in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `beforeSession` was never moved inside the `try` block, the two newly added tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` runs. Additionally, the candidate failed to remove the outdated recorded-flaw bullet in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, omitted the required explanation of what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened, and made no update to `CHANGELOG.md`.
